title: SQL 子查询 (Subquery)
description: SQL 工作流系列 (9/16)：标量子查询、IN/NOT IN、EXISTS/NOT EXISTS、ANY/ALL 与 FROM 子查询

content.content: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE user_id = (SELECT id FROM users WHERE name = 'Tom');
SELECT * FROM products WHERE price = (SELECT MAX(price) FROM products);
SELECT * FROM users WHERE id IN (SELECT user_id FROM orders WHERE amount > 1000);
SELECT * FROM users WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT user_id FROM orders);
SELECT * FROM users u WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.user_id = u.id);
SELECT * FROM users u WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.user_id = u.id);
SELECT * FROM products WHERE price > ANY (SELECT price FROM products WHERE category = 'book');
SELECT * FROM products WHERE price > ALL (SELECT price FROM products WHERE category = 'book');
SELECT t.user_id, t.total FROM (SELECT user_id, SUM(amount) AS total FROM orders GROUP BY user_id) t WHERE t.total > 1000;
